basicAuth.description: Enable HTTP Basic authentication. When enabled, the SDK populates `httpclient.Options.BasicAuth` from `basicAuthUser` / `secureJsonData.basicAuthPassword`.

database.description: Legacy index name. The backend falls back to it when `index` is empty; the editor clears it when `index` is edited.

apiKeyAuth.description: Send the API key as an `Authorization: ApiKey` header. Set by the authentication method selector.

dataLinks.description: Links added to matching fields in log row details.

datasourceUid.description: UID of the data source the link opens. Makes it an internal link.

field.description: Exact field name or a regex that matches it.

url.description: External URL, or a query when `datasourceUid` is set.

defaultQueryMode.description: Query mode new queries start in.

enableSecureSocksProxy.description: Route requests through Grafana's Secure Socks Proxy (Private Data source Connect). The editor only shows it when the Grafana instance enables the proxy.

httpHeaders.description: Additional HTTP headers sent with every request. Forwarded to the SDK as `httpclient.Options.Header`.

index.description: Name of your Elasticsearch index. You can use a time pattern, such as YYYY.MM.DD, or a wildcard for the index name.

interval.description: Time pattern of the index. Omit for no pattern.

keepCookies.description: Cookies, by name, that the Grafana proxy should forward to the datasource. The Grafana proxy strips all cookies by default.

logLevelField.description: Field that holds the level of each log message.

maxConcurrentShardRequests.description: Maximum number of concurrent shards a search request can hit per node. Non-positive values fall back to the default.

oauthPassThru.description: Forward the signed-in user's upstream OAuth identity (access token) to the datasource.

serverName.description: Server name used for TLS SNI / certificate verification. Forwarded to the SDK as `TLSOptions.ServerName`.

sigV4AssumeRoleArn.description: Optional. Role to assume with the selected authentication provider.

sigV4Auth.description: Sign requests with AWS SigV4. The editor only offers it when the Grafana instance enables SigV4 auth; provisioning can set it regardless.

sigV4AuthType.description: Which AWS credentials chain to use.

sigV4ExternalId.description: External ID required by the assumed role's trust policy, if any.

sigV4Profile.description: Profile name in the AWS credentials file. Leave blank for the default.

sigV4Region.description: AWS region used to sign requests, such as `us-east-1`.

timeInterval.description: Lower limit for the auto group-by time interval. Set it to the write frequency, for example 1m.

timeout.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds. Maps to `TimeoutOptions.Timeout` in the plugin SDK HTTP client.

tlsAuth.description: Validate using TLS client authentication, in which the server authenticates the client

tlsAuthWithCACert.description: Add your own Certificate Authority (CA) certificate on top of one generated by the certificate authorities for additional security measures

tlsSkipVerify.description: Skipping TLS certificate validation is not recommended unless absolutely necessary or for testing

url.description: Complete HTTP URL of the datasource (e.g. https://your-server:8080).

secureValues.description: PEM-encoded client certificate used for mTLS. Forwarded to the SDK as `TLSOptions.ClientCertificate`.
PEM-encoded private key paired with `tlsClientCert`. Forwarded to the SDK as `TLSOptions.ClientKey`.
